description: This PHP source file defines the CategoriesApiController class, which provides API endpoints for managing categories, social commitments, spheres, SDGs, footprints, and related properties in the Goteo platform. It includes actions for fetching category data, suggestions, uploading images, and updating properties.

classes.name: CategoriesApiController
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for category management in the Goteo platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, sets database replica and cache settings.

methods.name: validateCategories
methods.description: Validates access and existence of a category or related model based on tab and id.

methods.name: keywordsAction
methods.description: Returns a list of keyword tags for suggestions based on a query.

methods.name: categoriesAction
methods.description: Returns a list of categories or related entities based on the specified tab.

methods.name: uploadImagesAction
methods.description: Handles AJAX image uploads for categories.

methods.name: categoriesPropertyAction
methods.description: Checks or updates a property of a category or related model.
